Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Net Worth Surpasses $200 Billion

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's net worth has crossed $200 billion, making him the seventh-richest person globally. This surge is attributed to Nvidia's shares reaching a record high, driven by sustained demand for artificial intelligence chips and a recent buyback announcement. Huang's fortune increased by $3.4 billion.
